# WAF Scorecard

> Heuristic scoring of the analysed repository against the five pillars of the
> **Azure Well-Architected Framework (WAF)**.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

**This scorecard is heuristic and non-official.** Scores are generated by Aegis
based on automated repository analysis and do not represent an official
Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Review. For an official assessment, use the
[Azure Well-Architected Review tool](https://learn.microsoft.com/assessments/azure-architecture-review/).

---

## Scoring methodology

Each pillar is scored on a **0–5 scale**:

| Score | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | No evidence found |
| 1 | Minimal / ad-hoc |
| 2 | Some practices in place, significant gaps |
| 3 | Moderate — key practices present, improvements needed |
| 4 | Good — most best practices followed |
| 5 | Excellent — comprehensive alignment |

### Scoring inputs

- Repository structure and content analysis
- Secrets and configuration detection
- IaC presence and quality (Bicep lint results)
- CI/CD maturity (workflows, gates, approvals)
- Documentation completeness
- Architecture patterns (managed services, redundancy, monitoring)
